inference_operation: Constructed and executed conditional paired differential calibration with latent contrast parameter and arbitrary shared native means.
scope: Native/15/16 power checks within five candidate classes; static, registered before/after Poisson records. Not the full17-state operation.

final_fresh_seed_tests.scope:
Charged paired calibration with arbitrary shared native means.

Before mean: kb*b[k]. After mean: ka*(b[k]+delta_h[k](w)).
Each b[k] is unknown, w in [0,1] is inferred, and delta is the two-endpoint
training contrast family. Native/background labels and nuisance values are
not estimated by an oracle. Counts are split offline into independent Poisson
halves. Cross-fit split-likelihood confidence sets use ordinary universal
inference (Wasserman/Ramdas/Balakrishnan, PNAS 2020).
final_fresh_seed_tests.source: Actual multislice probabilities; exact independent Poisson counts aggregated by a training-only detector partition.
final_fresh_seed_tests.coverage: Exact procedure requires delta_truth=delta_h(w), shared static background, independent Poisson observations, known dose, and conservative null likelihood suprema. Computed profiles use floating-point supporting-tangent bounds, not interval certificates; numerical coverage is conditional on those bounds. Physical CrSBr coverage is not acquired.
final_fresh_seed_tests.schema_note: Out-of-class point labels are unsupported; point-error counters are not applicable. No count draws or decisions were changed.

paired_ratio_failure.scope:
Paired Poisson calibration eliminates arbitrary shared native intensities.

Given each feature's before+after total, the after count is binomial with
probability r/(z+r), z=D_before/D_after, r=candidate defect/native ratio.
The null r=1 is exact for any shared native pattern. Non-null ratios are a
physical transfer assumption. Thermal parameters are not supplied to inference.
paired_ratio_failure.truth: four-snapshot sigma=.1A templates; not acquired physics

ordinary_joint_nuisance_screen.scope:
Ordinary joint native-reference/depth calibration with latent nuisance.

The nuisance parameter w is inferred from counts, never supplied. The small
model is an intensity mixture between rigid and sigma=.1 A templates. This is
not asserted to describe intermediate temperatures or experimental CrSBr.
Held-out sigma=.065 A/independent-seed multislice truths test that coverage.
ordinary_joint_nuisance_screen.calibration_reference_state: Known native assumed; preparation and read survival not acquired.

training_only_compression.scope:
Training-only detector count partition for paired differential inference.

All detector/probe categories remain recorded. The software partition greedily
retains Bhattacharyya information from the ten training endpoint patterns.
Held-out truths are not accessed while choosing the partition.
training_only_compression.endpoint_order: rigid five classes then thermal five classes

history_boundary.scope:
Untimed detector counts do not label endpoints under arbitrary hidden paths.

At every probe dwell compare equal exposure in native and layer15, in opposite
temporal orders. The actual multislice template count integrals are identical.
State paths/reset timing are hypothetical, not an acquired transition law.
Time-resolved or transition-aware ordinary observation can escape this boundary.
history_boundary.templates: Frozen actual native and layer15 detector probabilities
history_boundary.quantifier: For a path class allowing both orders with equal occupation fractions within every retained dwell; no claim that measured CrSBr kinetics realize them.
history_boundary.escape: Retain sub-dwell timestamps/subframes and acquire a transition/observation law; an ordinary controller receives identical access.

core_limits: Native means do not identify the changed-state response family.
A native before-state is a preparation assumption; arbitrary background estimation does not prove purity.
Rejected drift/two-Cr controls do not establish rejection of every multiple-defect or species-loss state.
A static no-change envelope is a contract of this operation, not a universal necessity for time-resolved tracking.
Repeated reference reuse and optional stopping need their own dependence-aware construction.
